Landing.metaDescription: From posting listings and comparing quotes to contracts, invoices, and delivery confirmation. The B2B platform connecting Korean and Indonesian companies without language barriers.
Landing.heroTitle: The B2B Trading Platform Connecting Korea and Indonesia
Landing.heroEcho: Platform perdagangan B2B yang menghubungkan perusahaan Korea dan Indonesia
Landing.heroSubtitle: From posting listings and comparing quotes to contract confirmation, invoicing, and delivery confirmation — handle the entire trade process in one place, without language barriers.
Landing.heroCtaHint: Your role is set automatically by the country you choose at signup
Landing.heroDemoTranslated: When can the goods be shipped?
Landing.highlight4: One-stop from quote to delivery confirmation
Landing.stepsSubtitle: Complex trade procedures, organized into 5 steps
Landing.step1Desc: Register the items, quantities, and delivery terms you need
Landing.step2Desc: Compare quotes from multiple suppliers at a glance and ask questions via chat
Landing.step3Desc: Confirm the quote you like and a contract is created
Landing.step4Desc: An invoice is issued automatically; payment receipts and confirmations are recorded
Landing.step5Desc: Confirming receipt of goods completes the transaction record
Landing.buyerPoint1: Collect quotes from multiple Korean suppliers with a single listing
Landing.buyerPoint2: Compare quotes with lowest-price and fastest-delivery badges
Landing.buyerPoint3: Manage transaction records with receipt uploads and delivery confirmation
Landing.sellerPoint1: Browse purchase listings from Indonesian companies and submit quotes
Landing.sellerPoint2: Invoices issued automatically when a contract is confirmed
Landing.sellerPoint3: Manage payment confirmations and delivery status on one screen
Landing.trustTitle: A Trading Environment You Can Trust
Landing.trustSubtitle: The more cross-border the trade, the more records matter
Landing.trust1Desc: Payment receipts, payment confirmations, and delivery confirmations are recorded per contract, reducing the risk of disputes.
Landing.trust2Desc: A companies-only platform where members register with a business registration number (Korea) or NPWP·NIB (Indonesia).
Landing.trust3Desc: Quotes and invoices are generated in each party's language, and chat is auto-translated in real time.
Landing.faq1A: Indonesian buyer companies and Korean supplier companies can sign up. A business registration number (Korea) or NPWP·NIB (Indonesia) is required.
Landing.faq2Q: Can we trade even if we speak different languages?
Landing.faq2A: Yes. We support Korean, Indonesian, and English. Chat is auto-translated in real time, and documents like quotes and invoices are generated in each party's language.
Landing.faq3A: A buyer posts a listing and suppliers submit quotes. After comparing quotes and confirming a contract, an invoice is issued, and everything from payment confirmation to delivery confirmation is recorded on the platform.
Landing.faq4A: Payments are made via T/T bank transfer. Receipt uploads and the supplier's payment confirmation are recorded on the contract so both parties can track progress.
Landing.finalSubtitle: Right after signing up, you can post a listing or submit a quote

SniChecklist.disclaimer: This information is a reference summary only and has no legal effect. Please verify actual certification requirements directly with Indonesia's official authorities (Kemenperin/BSN) or a professional consultant.

office.summary: Pure stationery items have no confirmed mandatory status (uncertain). Electronic office equipment (printers, etc.) may fall under mandatory SNI for electronics — check item by item.

representativeItems.item: Electronic office equipment (printers, multifunction devices, etc.)
representativeItems.note: May fall under mandatory SNI for electronics/telecom equipment (uncertain, check individually)

lab.summary: Measuring instruments (scales, thermometers, etc.) fall under the mandatory SNI category. Whether non-measuring lab equipment is covered is uncertain.

representativeItems.item: Measuring instruments (scales, pressure gauges, thermometers, etc.)
representativeItems.note: Likely falls under the mandatory SNI category 'measuring instruments'

lab.estimatedDuration: 8 weeks to 6 months (estimated, based on general industry practice)

machinery.summary: 'Machinery, parts, and machine tools' are explicitly listed under the mandatory SNI category.

representativeItems.note: Individually ordered equipment (not consumer goods) may follow different standards (uncertain)

chemical.summary: 'Chemical raw materials and chemical products' are explicitly listed under the mandatory SNI category. Some items may instead be subject to Kemendag K3L (Security, Safety, Health, Environment) product registration — first determine whether SNI or K3L applies (in principle mutually exclusive, though uncertain based on a single source). K3L is applied for via OSS by Indonesia-based businesses (importers) holding an NIB, free of charge, valid for 5 years.

representativeItems.note: First determine whether SNI or K3L applies (K3L's 42 product groups are presumed to focus on finished products containing chemicals; whether raw materials are included is unconfirmed in the source)
Likely subject to K3L registration (uncertain, check individually). K3L applicant is presumed to be the Indonesia-based importer

chemical.estimatedDuration: 8 weeks to 6+ months (estimated, K3L may add additional time)

other.summary: Cannot be generalized due to the nature of this category. When registering, we recommend checking Kemenperin's official mandatory SNI list by item name individually.
